entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: 1. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.232/2017 dated 21.07.2017, for commission of offences under Sections 420/406/34 of IPC, registered at P.S. Sarita Vihar.
2. It is apprised that the matter is at the stage of arguments on charge before the learned Magisterial Court, and parties have already argued in part.
3. In view of the above, learned counsel for the petitioner would take requisite instructions in the matter.

4. List on 24.04.2026.
MANOJ JAIN, J FEBRUARY 4, 2026/
